title: Pic proper curve torsion component
statement: Let C be a proper smooth connected dimension-one curve over an algebraically closed field k [def-sc-curves], with genus g [def-sc-genus], Picard group Pic(C) [def-sc-picard-group], and degree-zero subgroup Pic⁰(C) [def-sc-pic0]. Let n be a natural number whose image in k is nonzero. Then Pic(C)[n] is isomorphic as a group to (ℤ/nℤ)^(2g).

proof.text: Install f as the structure morphism. By [def-sc-curves] C is connected and dimension one. Finite type gives local Noetherianity by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian]; smoothness gives regularity by [lem-sc-smooth-regular]. The irreducibility argument of [lem-sc-regular-connected-integral], implemented by IsRegular.irreducibleSpace, gives irreducibility. Apply smoothOfRelativeDimension_iff_topologicalKrullDim_eq to obtain relative dimension one. By [lem-weil-separably-closed-geometrically-connected] C is geometrically connected. Apply GeometricallyIrreducible.of_smooth_of_geometricallyConnected: every field base change is smooth, locally Noetherian, regular and connected, hence irreducible. Smoothness gives geometric reducedness by [sbc-lem-smooth-geometrically-reduced]. Combine these to get geometric integrality.

Apply exists_jacobian of [thm-sc-jacobian-representability] to obtain J and the multiplicative equivalence picardZero k C ≃* J(k). Properness, smoothness and geometric integrality make J an abelian variety. Its relative dimension is the arithmetic genus, so topologicalKrullDim_eq_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension and IsAbelianVariety.topologicalKrullDim_eq identify its dimension with that genus. Apply [lem-pc-genus-agrees-sc] to identify it with f.genus of [def-sc-genus].

The nonzero image of n implies n ≠ 0 and, by CharP.cast_eq_zero_iff, that ringChar k does not divide n. Clause (c) of abelianVariety_estimate_of_isAlgClosed in [thm-av-final] gives an additive equivalence from the n-torsion of J(k) to (ZMod n)^(2 * dim J).

Use the degree homomorphism defining [def-sc-pic0]. If L^n = 1, its image satisfies n * degree(L) = 0 in ℤ. The nonzero integer n forces degree(L) = 0. Thus inclusion identifies the power-map kernel in Pic(C) with the kernel in picardZero k C. The private kernelEquiv restricts the Jacobian equivalence to power-map kernels. The private kernelTorsionEquiv identifies a multiplicative power-map kernel with the multiplicative form of AddSubgroup.torsionBy (Additive G) n. Compose these equivalences with the additive torsion calculation of step 3, and rewrite dim J = f.genus.

proof_origin.place: X2 stage 3: Jacobian calculation; geometric connectedness replaces rational-point construction, and injectivity of multiplication on ℤ replaces the split degree sequence.

theorem Scheme.Hom.pic_proper_ntorsion_torsion
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] [IsProper f]
    (n : ℕ) (_hn : (n : k) ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty ((powMonoidHom n : C.Pic →* C.Pic).ker ≃*
      Multiplicative (Fin (2 * f.genus) → ZMod n))
